Title: AWS Config Rule Failed: restricted-ssh
Description: Resource sg-06f92c30d1042feb2 violated compliance rule restricted-ssh
ISO_27001_2022: A.8.20 (Network Security), A.8.21 (Security of Network Services)
NIST_CSF: PR.AC-5 (Network Integrity & Access Controls), PR.PT-4 (Network Protection)
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 5.2 (Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22)
RemediationAction: Update security group rules to restrict port 22 to specific bastion or VPN CIDR ranges, or replace SSH with AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.

Title: CloudTrail should be enabled and configured with at least one multi-Region trail that includes read and write management events
Description: This AWS control checks that there is at least one multi-region AWS CloudTrail trail includes read and write management events.
NIST_CSF: DE.CM-1 (Network and Asset Monitoring), PR.PT-1 (Audit Log Generation & Integrity)
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 3.1 (Ensure CloudTrail is enabled across all regions)
RemediationAction: Enable multi-Region CloudTrail with management event logging and log file validation.

Title: AWS Config Rule Failed: s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited
Description: Resource cloud-compliance-demo-public-demo-oxcof074 violated compliance rule s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 2.1.5 (Ensure S3 Bucket Access is Restricted)
RemediationAction: Apply S3 Public Access Block at account and bucket level. Remove open principal wildcard (*) from bucket policy.

Title: AWS Config Rule Failed: iam-user-mfa-enabled
Description: Resource cloud-compliance-demo-contractor-no-mfa violated compliance rule iam-user-mfa-enabled
NIST_CSF: PR.AC-1 (Identities and Credentials Issued), PR.AC-7 (Users Authenticated)
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 1.10 (Ensure MFA is enabled for all IAM users that have a console password)
RemediationAction: Enforce virtual or hardware MFA via IAM policy (aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent) or migrate IAM users to AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO).

Title: S3 general purpose buckets should require requests to use TLS
Description: This control checks whether an Amazon S3 general purpose bucket has a policy that requires requests to use TLS. The control fails if the bucket policy doesn't require requests to use TLS.
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 2.1.2 (Ensure S3 Bucket Policy Requires Requests to Use TLS)
RemediationAction: Attach bucket policy with Deny statement for Condition aws:SecureTransport = false.

Title: S3 general purpose buckets should have block public access settings enabled

CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 2.1.5 (Ensure S3 Bucket Access is Restricted)
RemediationAction: Apply S3 Public Access Block at account and bucket level. Remove open principal wildcard (*) from bucket policy.

Title: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum password length of 14 or greater
Description: Password policies are, in part, used to enforce password complexity requirements. IAM password policies can be used to ensure passwords are at least a given length. It is recommended that the password policy require a minimum password length 14.
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 1.8 (Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater)
RemediationAction: Update IAM account password policy to require MinimumPasswordLength >= 14.

Title: AWS Config Rule Failed: encrypted-volumes
Description: Resource vol-0d35a3ca9a7c6de4b violated compliance rule encrypted-volumes
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 2.2.1 (Ensure EBS Volume Encryption is Enabled)
RemediationAction: Enable EBS default encryption using AWS KMS (aws/ebs or customer-managed CMK). Snapshot volume and re-create with encryption enabled.

Title: VPC flow logging should be enabled in all VPCs
Description: This control checks whether Amazon Virtual Private Cloud flow logs are found and enabled for Amazon VPCs. The traffic type is set to 'Reject'.
NIST_CSF: DE.CM-1 (Network and Asset Monitoring), PR.PT-4 (Network Protection)
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 3.9 (Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs)
RemediationAction: Create VPC flow logs for all active and default VPCs to CloudWatch Logs or S3.

Title: EBS default encryption should be enabled
Description: This control checks whether Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) encryption is enabled by default. The control fails if EBS default encryption is not enabled.
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 2.2.1 (Ensure EBS Volume Encryption is Enabled)
RemediationAction: Enable EBS default encryption using AWS KMS (aws/ebs or customer-managed CMK). Snapshot volume and re-create with encryption enabled.

Title: Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse
Description: IAM password policies can prevent the reuse of a given password by the same user. It is recommended that the password policy prevent the reuse of passwords.

RemediationAction: Set password reuse prevention to 24 in IAM password policy.

RemediationAction: Create an IAM role with AWSSupportAccess managed policy attached.
